item.title: Indianapolis homicides on track for 8-year low
item.description: Indianapolis has seen a significant drop in crime this year, with homicides down nearly 20% and nonfatal shootings down 21%, due to the city's Gun Violence Reduction Strategy, proactive policing, and investments in the police department.

item.title: How New Year’s Eve fireworks can impact veterans with PTSD
item.description: Veterans living with PTSD in Indianapolis are experiencing intense memories, anxiety, and stress due to the sudden bursts of fireworks, and IMPD is urging residents to be mindful of their neighbors.
